how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:warrior-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1818:details:0: I was told Deathguard Dillinger has a job for someone like you. If you're willing to show your value to the Dark Lady's forces, then report to Dillinger immediately.
rows.quest:1818:details:1: BDeathguard Dillinger's post is on the west end of ⟦E1⟧, near the graveyard.
rows.quest:1818:completion:0: You're here for a mission? Good. I have an important one, and one that will test your skill in combat... and your resolve in the defense of the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1819:obj:0: Kill Ulag the Cleaver, then speak with Deathguard Dillinger.
rows.quest:1819:details:0: When the Scourge swept through ⟦E3⟧, we captured one to study. He had a free mind, and called himself Ulag the Cleaver. But, although his will was free, he was still enthralled by the Lich King.
rows.quest:1819:details:1: BWe hoped to find a way to break the king's control over Ulag, but we failed. Now, finally, it is time to free him.
rows.quest:1819:details:3: BActivate the skull stone trigger near the mausoleum to the north. This will lift the magical seal that binds him.
rows.quest:1819:completion:0: Well done, ⟦2⟧. Ulag was no minor agent of the Scourge. You have shown the Deathguards, and hence the Dark Lady, that you are a warrior of skill and resolve, and are worthy of further instruction.
rows.quest:1820:details:0: You have proven your value to the Dark Lady, now perhaps you can prove yourself to one of her subjects.
rows.quest:1820:details:1: BColeman Farthing awaits a warrior who is willing to be his instrument of revenge against the ⟦E2⟧'s enemies.
rows.quest:1820:details:2: BYou will find him in the Gallow's End Tavern in eastern ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1820:completion:0: Yes, it is true. I have need for your skills in combat. My means are small, but my task aids both me and the ⟦E2⟧'s cause. Do it, and your reward will be twofold.
rows.quest:1821:obj:0: Bring Coleman Farthing the Agamand Family Axe, the Agamand Family ⟦E4⟧, the Agamand Family Mace and the Agamand Family dagger.
rows.quest:1821:details:0: The Agamand family were my employers in life, and they were the cause of my death! It is fitting that the Agamands are now mindless minions of the Lich King.
rows.quest:1821:details:1: BNow I would have their last vestiges of honor. Go into their family crypt and rob them of their family heirlooms: a sword, an axe, a dagger and a mace. Bring them to me!
rows.quest:1821:details:2: BThe Agamand family crypt is at the north end of the Agamand mills, protected by lurking scourge and dead Agamands.
rows.quest:1821:completion:0: Ah! You retrieved them! Now the last semblance of honor and memory is stripped from the cursed Agamand lands. The family truly is no more!
rows.quest:1822:completion:0: I will keep three of the weapons you returned to me, as mementos of my pain and loss. But please, ⟦3⟧, choose your favorite of the heirlooms and keep it for yourself.
rows.quest:1822:completion:1: BMay it serve you greater than it served its cursed, former owners.
rows.quest:1823:details:0: You are a warrior of skill and growing renown. Perhaps you are ready for Ruga Ragetotem's trial? If so, then find Ruga in Camp Taurajo in the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:1823:details:1: BHe awaits those warriors who answer his call.
rows.quest:1823:completion:0: You are here for my trial, ⟦4⟧?
rows.quest:1824:obj:0: Bring 5 twitching antennae to Ruga Ragetotem at Camp Taurajo
rows.quest:1824:details:0: To pass this trial, you must travel south to the Field of Giants. There you will find a host of crawling, insect creatures. They are new to the ⟦E5⟧ and I do not like what they herald.
rows.quest:1824:details:1: BBring me their still-twitching antennae, and waste no time, ⟦5⟧, for harvested antennae will not twitch for long. Bring me the antennae in the time allowed, and you will pass the trial.
rows.quest:1824:completion:0: Nicely done, ⟦6⟧! In passing the trial at the Field of Giants, you take one more step down the warrior's path.
rows.quest:1825:obj:0: Speak with Thun'grim Firegaze in the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:1825:details:0: Thun'grim Firegaze, an orc blacksmith of renown, has heard of your continued deeds of valor in service of the ⟦E6⟧. He would like to fashion for you a suit of armor, and bids you speak with him immediately.
rows.quest:1825:details:1: BThun'grim is camped east of the Crossroads in the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:1825:completion:0: Yes, you have come. This is good, for we have much to discuss, you and I.
rows.quest:1838:obj:0: Bring to Thun'grim Firegaze 15 Smoky Iron Ingots, 10 Powdered Azurite, 10 Iron Bars and a Vial of Phlogiston.
rows.quest:1838:details:0: I have heard tales of your strength and valor, and wish to make for you a suit of armor, a companion to aid you as tales of your great deeds grow.
rows.quest:1838:details:1: BBut the fashioning of this armor will be a quest unto itself, ⟦7⟧. I will need your help, and the help of other smiths of the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:1838:details:2: BHere, take this scroll. I spent many nights, struggling with near-blind eyes, writing that which I need for the armor. Bring me the items on this scroll and I will create for you the first piece of the suit.
rows.quest:1838:completion:0: You brought all that I asked. Now, I will do my part...
rows.quest:1839:details:0: The troll smith Ula'elek will craft for you the brutal gauntlets. He dwells in ⟦E7⟧, in Sen'jin Village with his ⟦E8⟧ brethren, and he awaits your coming.
rows.quest:1839:completion:0: Greetings, ⟦8⟧. Old Thun'grim sent word to me of your coming, but had he kept silent your presence here would not have surprised me.
rows.quest:1839:completion:1: BThe spirits follow your progress, young warrior, and they tell me that many foes have fallen before you.
rows.quest:1840:details:0: Orm Stonehoof is respected greatly for his skill. He will make for you the brutal helm.
rows.quest:1840:details:1: BSeek him out in ⟦E9⟧, near the pool by the city's great, central totem.
rows.quest:1840:completion:0: Greetings, warrior. I am Orm, and Thun'grim tells me you wish a helm made?
rows.quest:1841:obj:0: Speak with Velora Nitely in the ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:1841:details:0: It is said that, before her death, Velora Nitely was one of the finest armorsmiths in Lordaeron. Death, it seems, has not decreased her talents. Speak with Velora--she will make your brutal legguards.
rows.quest:1841:details:1: BVelora plies her trade in the ⟦E10⟧ of Lordaeron, in the trade quarter.
rows.quest:1841:completion:0: You are here for leg armor? Great!
rows.quest:1841:completion:1: BUm... am I making the armor for you, or are you making it for me?
rows.quest:1841:completion:2: BThat was joke. Was it funny? I can't tell... I lost my sense of humor the same time I lost my sense of smell. Which was about the same time I stopped breathing.
rows.quest:1842:obj:0: Bring 7 Uncloven Satyr Hooves to Ula'elek at Sen'jin Village in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:1842:details:0: I can make you a pair of brutal gauntlets, and great magic will they hold. But first, you must collect this magic and bring it to me.
rows.quest:1842:details:1: BThe satyrs dwell in northeastern ⟦E11⟧ because of the forest's power. They feed off its purity, leeching and corrupting. You can tell which satyrs have drawn the most of ⟦E11⟧'s magic by their swollen, uncloven hooves.
rows.quest:1842:details:2: BThese hooves hold great power. I will need them for your gauntlets' crafting.
rows.quest:1842:completion:0: Ah, you have them! Now, just as the Satyrs leeched the strength of ⟦E11⟧, I will leech the power held within these hooves and harness it into my crafting...
rows.quest:1843:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦9⟧. These gauntlets are my best work. Take them. In wearing them, you bring honor to me and my ancestors.
rows.quest:1844:obj:0: Bring a Galvanized Horn to Orm Stonehoof in ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:1844:details:0: I will make you the helm, but you must show me you are worthy of it.
rows.quest:1844:details:1: BNestled in the northwestern reaches of the ⟦E12⟧ there lies the Charred Vale. It was once a verdant place, but is now defiled and ashen, and what creatures remain there are mad with pain and despair.
rows.quest:1844:details:2: BThat place is where I send you, ⟦10⟧.
rows.quest:1844:details:3: BYou must go to the Charred Vale and find a chimaera matriarch. Slay her, free her of her misery. Bring me her galvanized horn as proof, and I shall make for you the helm.
rows.quest:1844:completion:0: You have completed your task, ⟦11⟧, and shown me your worth and resolve. The helm will be yours...
rows.quest:1845:completion:0: I give this helm to you.
rows.quest:1845:completion:1: BGreat deeds brought you to me, ⟦12⟧, and Earthmother willing... even greater deeds lie before you.
rows.quest:1846:obj:0: Bring 8 Sturdy Dragonmaw Shinbones to Velora Nitely in the ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:1846:details:0: To make the brutal ⟦E13⟧, I need a brace of sturdy shinbones. The Dragonmaw orcs of the ⟦E14⟧ have nice, thick shinbones. I'll need theirs.
rows.quest:1846:details:1: BBut they must be sturdy. Be sure to test the shinbones as you collect them. If you can break them with your bare hands, then they won't be sturdy enough to work with.
rows.quest:1846:completion:0: Well done! These all look strong. I think they'll do quite nicely. How did those orcs mind you taking their shins, ⟦13⟧? Complain much?
rows.quest:1846:completion:1: BThat was another joke. You're not laughing.
rows.quest:1846:completion:2: BI'm not very funny these days, am I...
rows.quest:1847:completion:0: Here are your legguards, ⟦14⟧. Let me know how they fit or if you need any modifications. I aim to please! At least I used to.
rows.quest:1847:completion:1: BThese days I don't care much for my craft. But it beats being a mindless minion of the Scourge!
rows.quest:1848:completion:0: I am sure you endured much hardship and shed much blood on my task, ⟦15⟧. Here is the product of your toil.
rows.quest:1848:completion:1: BMay you wear it well, and may you one day return here with stories of its service to you.
rows.quest:2383:obj:0: Read the Simple Parchment and speak to Frang in the Valley of Trials.
rows.quest:2383:details:0: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, ⟦16⟧.
rows.quest:2383:details:1: BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the warrior trainer Frang. He would have words with you when you're ready. You'll find him outside the Den, taking cover in the shade.
rows.quest:2383:completion:0: Ah, that's my parchment. I heard you'd be coming to the Valley, ⟦17⟧. I'm glad to see you made it--let's hope you survive the trials ahead. Like I said, as you gain in power, come to me--I will do what I can to train you in the ways of the warrior.
rows.quest:2383:completion:1: BGood luck, ⟦18⟧, and return to me whenever you feel ready.
rows.quest:3065:obj:0: Read the Simple Tablet and speak to Frang in the Valley of Trials.
rows.quest:3065:details:0: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, ⟦19⟧.
rows.quest:3065:details:1: BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the warrior trainer Frang. He would have words with you when you're ready. You'll find him outside the Den, taking cover in the shade.
rows.quest:3065:completion:0: You'll find this place fitting as you continue to train in the warrior ways. If you have any questions, feel free to ask anyone around, and when you feel you're ready, come back to me for training. I've mastered as much as any warrior here in the Valley and can pass that knowledge on to you... for a price.
rows.quest:3091:obj:0: Read the Simple Note and speak to Harutt Thunderhorn in ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:3091:details:0: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, ⟦20⟧. I believe she was sent by the warrior trainer Harutt. If this note is from Harutt, I wouldn't take long in reading it's contents.⟦21⟧
rows.quest:3091:completion:0: Each of us plays a role in our tribe. Each of us must also go through all the same rites. Do not ever let your pride tell you otherwise.
rows.quest:3091:completion:1: BI remain here to train new warriors that seek the glory of battle and who follow the ways of our oldest ancestors. When you feel ready, come back to me and I will do what I can to train you further. Go with the tribe's blessing, ⟦22⟧.
rows.quest:3095:obj:0: Read the Simple Scroll and speak to Dannal Stern in Deathknell.
rows.quest:3095:details:0: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the warrior trainer Dannal. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.
rows.quest:3095:completion:0: I will be here to train you as you grow in experience... find me as often as you like. I charge a minimal fee, but you'll find everything I can teach you to be worthwhile.
rows.quest:3095:completion:1: BGo now and test your skill. Many more things will become known to you as you gain experience, some of which I am unable to discuss with you here. Just know that Sylvanas will need warriors with your type of strength in the future. You will be the backbone of our ⟦E16⟧. Do not forget it.
rows.quest:3100:obj:0: Read the Simple Letter and speak to Llane Beshere in ⟦E17⟧ Abbey.
rows.quest:3100:details:0: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, ⟦23⟧. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Llane, our local warrior trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
rows.quest:3100:completion:0: Get yourself squared away, learn the layout of the land, and come back to me whenever you need training. I'll be here night or day.
rows.quest:3100:completion:1: BThe ⟦E18⟧ have done well in making this place fairly safe, but as you meet the other citizens, I think you'll find they all have problems they could use some help with--help a warrior can give them. Good luck.
rows.quest:3106:obj:0: Read the Simple Rune and speak to Thran Khorman in Coldridge Valley.
rows.quest:3106:details:0: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the warrior trainer Thran. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
rows.quest:3106:completion:0: Other things you'll probably see too, just so yer in the know: dwarves usin' magic in a fight 'stead of a rifle. Some of us takin' to worshippin' the ⟦E19⟧ like some of the humans, and, last but not least, troggs. You'll learn more 'bout them later, but what you need to know now is that I'm here to help ya.
rows.quest:3106:completion:1: BI be here to teach ya how to be a real warrior. Anytime ya think ya need more trainin', come back to me and I'll see what I can do.
rows.quest:3112:obj:0: Read the Simple Memorandum and speak to Thran Khorman in Coldridge Valley.
rows.quest:3112:details:0: While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the warrior trainer Thran. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
rows.quest:3112:completion:0: Well, seein' how this is your prime directive, or whatever yer callin' it these days, I gave my word I'd do whatever I can to make sure you and yours were ready to take back your home... and that's just what I'm gonna do.
rows.quest:3112:completion:1: BAny time you feel yer ready, come back to good ol' Thran and I'll be happy to share my knowledge wit ya. There's some cost to me trainin' ya, but it won't be too expensive. Good luck.
rows.quest:3116:obj:0: Read the Simple Sigil and speak to Alyissia in ⟦E20⟧.
rows.quest:3116:details:0: This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our warrior trainer, Alyissia. It seems Alyissia would have words with you when you have a moment. Read it and bring it to her afterwards.
rows.quest:3116:completion:0: Soon you will see others from different races in the boughs of our home--do not let it cause any prejudice within you. They are welcome. They will aid us when they can. Not all of them will be altruistic, but they should be granted some amount of trust.
rows.quest:3116:completion:1: BBut none of this matters now. Now we must focus on you, and how you can aid our people. I am here for that very purpose. I will train you in the ways of a warrior as you become stronger. Return to me whenever you wish and I will do what I can to aid you.
rows.quest:8417:obj:0: Speak with the Fallen Hero of the ⟦E6⟧ at the entrance to the ⟦E21⟧.
rows.quest:8417:details:0: In the ⟦E21⟧, there is a troubled spirit who was once a great hero of the horde. A warrior's honor does not die with the body, and it would serve you well to speak with him.
rows.quest:8417:completion:0: So, you have come to alleviate my pain. I wish you could simply strike me down, but it is not that simple...
rows.quest:8423:obj:0: Kill 7 Helboar in the ⟦E21⟧ and return to the Fallen Hero of the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:8423:details:1: BYou are a ⟦25⟧, no doubt. I would ask an honorable task of you, but I must test your strength.
rows.quest:8423:details:2: BIt is said that Rexxar would measure the sharpness of his blades by killing a helboar with a single, swift strike. Now I will measure your strength by killing them.
rows.quest:8423:completion:0: I need no proof to know what you have done, warrior. I can see the determination etched in your expression.
rows.quest:8424:obj:0: Slaughter the Shadowsworn in the ⟦E21⟧ and return to the Fallen Hero of the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:8424:details:0: The continued presence of the shadowsworn in the ⟦E21⟧ bring great pain to me. Their dark rituals and spells cause agony unlike any I felt while alive.
rows.quest:8424:details:1: BThrough you I can deliver my own message of pain. Go forth and deliver my wrath.
rows.quest:8424:completion:0: Already you have subdued my pain and honored me. Thank you, warrior.
rows.quest:8425:obj:0: Bring the Voodoo Feathers from the trolls in the Sunken Temple to the Fallen Hero of the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:8425:details:0: Your honor has brought some peace to me. It is only right that I offer you something in return.
rows.quest:8425:details:1: BMy weapons and armor were splendid in life, and yet they are of no use to me now. They would be better served in your possession.
rows.quest:8425:details:2: BTravel to the sunken temple and destroy the troll guardians Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Hukku, Zul'lor, and Loro. They carry magic feathers that can reform my physical body long enough to grant you a reward.
rows.quest:8425:completion:0: At last I can feel the cold touch of steel again, even if only for a moment.
